details: For every finite binary class, the stronger counting bound $\mathrm E(\mathcal H)\geq2^{\mathrm{VC}^{*a}(\mathcal H)-1}-1$ holds. In particular $\mathrm E(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{VC}^{*a}(\mathcal H)-1$.
proof: If d concepts are dually antipodally shattered, each of the $2^{d-1}$ complementary pairs of label patterns is realized, up to a global label flip, by a coordinate. The pair consisting of the all-zero and all-one patterns is the only pair whose realizing coordinate can be constant on the chosen concepts. Every other pair is nonconstant, so its coordinate is effective. Thus at least $2^{d-1}-1$ effective coordinates occur. Since $2^{d-1}-1\geq d-1$ for every d, the stated affine bound follows.
name: Effective Range / Dual Antipodal VC Dimension (affine)
